summary: Completed testing of RDS Stations dynamic configuration feature. Backend API tests all pass (12/12). Frontend tests confirm: Create Site Wizard shows Stations step for radio type, skips it for non-radio types. Edit Site Wizard has Stations tab for radio sites. RDS Builder, RDS Settings, and RDS Monitor pages all dynamically load stations from API.

fixed.issue: Route ordering bug - bulk-sync was being matched by /{station_id} route first
fixed.fix: Moved bulk-sync route definition before the station_id routes in rds_stations.py

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI routers is critical - more specific routes (like /bulk-sync) must be defined before parameterized routes (like /{station_id})
seed_data_creation: MFY and GRK stations restored for radiogroep site after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: RDS Stations feature is fully functional. Backend route ordering bug was fixed. All CRUD operations work. Create wizard shows Stations step for radio type only. Edit wizard has Stations tab for radio sites. RDS Builder/Settings/Monitor pages dynamically load stations.
